sampleFindings.title: Apex Seal Compression Test
sampleFindings.why: Ask for a compression test printout. Each rotor should read above 8.5 bar / 120 psi.

sampleFindings.title: Coolant-in-Oil / Rotor Housing Leak
sampleFindings.why: Pull the dipstick and look for milky oil. White smoke on a cold start is the clearest warning sign.

sampleFindings.title: Catalytic Converter Condition
sampleFindings.why: Rotaries run rich and destroy catalytic converters. Listen for a rattle under the car at idle.
